title.zh: 当着所有人的面约定一个秘密

desc.zh: 两个陌生人在谁都能偷听的线路上，怎么约定一个只有他俩知道的秘密？从单向函数、Diffie–Hellman、RSA、椭圆曲线和证书，到量子威胁、格密码和 2026 年的后量子迁移，每一步都在页面里真算一遍。
desc.en: How can two strangers agree on a secret while everyone listens? One-way functions, Diffie–Hellman, RSA, elliptic curves and certificates, then the quantum threat, lattices and the post-quantum migration as of 2026, each step computed for real in the page.

desc.zh: 对称密码要求两人先有同一把钥匙；n 个人两两通信要 n(n−1)/2 把，公钥让每人只需一对。
desc.en: Symmetric ciphers need a shared key first; n people need n(n−1)/2 keys pairwise, while public keys need one pair each.

zh: 对称密码和非对称密码的区别
en: how to share a key securely

title.en: One-way functions and the discrete logarithm

desc.zh: 平方再乘让模幂只要 2(k−1) 次乘法，倒推指数却要一个个试或小步大步，在页面里真的赛跑。
desc.en: Square-and-multiply needs at most 2(k−1) multiplications; recovering the exponent needs brute force or baby-step giant-step, raced live in the page.

title.zh: Diffie–Hellman 密钥交换与中间人攻击
title.en: Diffie–Hellman key exchange and the man in the middle

desc.zh: 两人只交换 g^a、g^b 就得到同一个 g^ab；偷听者要倒推，站在中间的人却不必。
desc.en: Exchanging only g^a and g^b gives both sides g^ab; an eavesdropper must invert, a man in the middle need not.

zh: 两个陌生人怎么约定秘密
公开线路上怎么配钥匙
en: how can two strangers agree on a secret

title.zh: RSA 签名、可塑性与填充

desc.zh: 签名是把 RSA 倒过来用；教科书 RSA 能被乘法篡改，e = 3 加短消息开立方根就破，所以必须填充。
desc.en: A signature is RSA run backwards; textbook RSA can be scaled by an attacker and broken by a cube root when e = 3, hence padding.

zh: 为什么 RSA 要填充

desc.zh: 曲线上的点加法构成群，倍点再加正着快、倒着只有 √n 的 ρ 方法，所以 256 位曲线抵得上 3072 位 RSA。
desc.en: Points on a curve form a group; double-and-add is fast and the best inverse is Pollard rho at √n, so a 256-bit curve matches 3072-bit RSA.

zh: 为什么椭圆曲线钥匙更短
en: why are elliptic curve keys shorter

title.zh: 签名、证书链与 TLS 握手
title.en: Signatures, certificate chains and the TLS handshake

desc.zh: 先哈希再签名；证书把公钥和名字绑在一起，由一条签名链连到浏览器预装的根证书。
desc.en: Hash, then sign; a certificate binds a key to a name, chained by signatures to a root the browser already trusts.

zh: 浏览器怎么知道网站是真的

title.en: Bits of security and the number field sieve

desc.zh: 安全位数是最好的已知攻击要的运算次数的 log₂；数域筛让 RSA 的钥匙要比安全位数长一个数量级。
desc.en: Bits of security are log₂ of the best known attack's cost; the number field sieve makes RSA keys an order of magnitude longer than their security.

en: how long should an RSA key be

title.zh: 量子威胁：Shor、Grover 与先存后解
title.en: The quantum threat: Shor, Grover, harvest now decrypt later

desc.zh: Shor 用找周期分解整数，打掉 RSA 和椭圆曲线；Grover 只把对称密码的位数减半；Mosca 不等式说明为什么现在就要迁移。
desc.en: Shor factors by period finding and breaks RSA and elliptic curves; Grover only halves symmetric bits; Mosca's inequality says why migration starts now.

zh: 量子计算机能破解 RSA 吗

title.en: Lattices, learning with errors and ML-KEM

desc.zh: 好基和坏基找最近格点；带噪声的线性方程组让高斯消元失效；页面里跑一个能解错的 Regev 加密，再看 ML-KEM 的参数和大小。
desc.en: Good and bad bases for the closest vector; noise defeats Gaussian elimination; a working Regev scheme that can fail to decrypt, then ML-KEM's parameters and sizes.

title.zh: 后量子迁移的前沿（2026 年）

desc.zh: 已发布的标准、浏览器与系统的部署、被攻破的候选方案和分解纪录，以及量子资源估计，每条都标了日期和出处。
desc.en: Published standards, browser and system deployment, broken candidates and factoring records, and quantum resource estimates, each dated and sourced.
